messages.content: content burnout ar just tired howar modhhe difference ta bujhte chai, explain koro

Just tired howa ekta rest e thik hoye jai - ekta weekend off nile fresh feel koro abar, content banate mon chai. Content burnout onek deeper level e hoy.

Content burnout e, jei jinis tumi age genuinely enjoy korte, seta o chore lage. Camera on korার idea tei dread feel hoy. Creative idea ashe na, blank feel hoy. Ar sobcheye important, rest nileo eta thik hoy na sathe sathe - eta weeks lagte pare recover korte.

Ekta simple test: jodi ekta hopta off nile abar excited lage content banate, seta just tired chilo. Jodi off nileo dread ta continue kore, seta burnout, ar deeper intervention lagbe - shudhu rest na, boundary, expectation, ar maybe kichu somoyer jonno completely alada kichu try kora.
